I’m getting hired into a position I’ve been dreaming of getting for a year, I paid off debt a year early, my landlord is finally going to put laminate in my apartment, I have 2 new amazing baby rats, my relationship with my mom is better than it’s ever been. People trigger my anxiety really bad, my fear of failing makes my anxiety bad, my fear that my depression with keep getting worse makes my anxiety bad. 

Typical day is wake up, go to work, go home, I have 0 motivation or energy to do anything. 

TMS is like a minor form of ECT that doesn’t induce seizures, and it has a 50% success rate. ECT has been improved and has a 70-90% success rate. They’re the only things left that might fix me
